Azure App Service is the bound adapter. Forward deploy publishes the candidate to the deployment slot named by rollbackTarget, then swaps that slot into production; rollback swaps it back. The slot therefore always holds the immediately-previous build.

This binding scopes the governed self-evolution candidate pipeline only (promotion evaluate -> deploy-candidate -> post-deploy control -> rollback). It does NOT enable production deploys of this control-plane app itself: promoted-production-deploy.yml still exits non-zero on every path, and its agent_workspace_promotions + GitHub environment approval gate is unchanged.
A merged PR may auto-deploy only when its candidate head commit has a successful dsg/promotion status emitted after Cinema VERIFIED_RAW_EVIDENCE and Control Plane ALLOW.
Supported deployment adapters are allowlisted; arbitrary commands from configuration are never executed.
Rollback execution requires a bound HTTPS rollback adapter endpoint plus DSG_PRODUCTION_ROLLBACK_SECRET; config never becomes shell authority.
Not verified live: no rollback or forward deploy has yet been executed against a real Azure subscription from this binding.
